av-rental-nyc.title: AV Rental NYC: Audio, Video, Lighting & Screens | Possible AV
av-rental-nyc.desc: AV rental in New York City with the crew included: screens, projectors, sound, microphones, lighting, staging, streaming and Wi-Fi, delivered from Brooklyn.

mainEntity.name: Does AV rental in NYC include setup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every rental goes out with our crew: delivery, setup, a technician while it runs, and strike.

mainEntity.name: Can I rent just one piece of equipment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A single TV, projector or speaker is a normal job. It still arrives set up and tested.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver across all five boroughs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver from Brooklyn to Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and Staten Island, and to Jersey City and Long Island.

mainEntity.name: What if you do not carry something?

acceptedAnswer.text: We source it and bring it in with everything else, on the same quote and the same schedule.

mainEntity.name: Do you rent LED walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: LED walls are rented through our sister site, ledwall.nyc, and we plan them in with the rest of the AV.

audio-visual-company-nyc.title: Audio Visual Company in NYC: Rental, Install & Production | Possible AV
audio-visual-company-nyc.desc: A Brooklyn, New York audio visual company: AV rental for events, AV installation for offices, showrooms and homes, and full production, all in house.

mainEntity.name: What does an audio visual company do?

acceptedAnswer.text: It supplies and runs the screens, sound, lighting and networks for events, and designs and installs AV systems for offices, showrooms and homes. Possible AV does both, in house.

mainEntity.name: Do you install AV in offices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes: conference rooms, lobbies and showrooms, including displays, audio, control, cabling and the network, with training and support after.

mainEntity.name: Do you install home theater in New York?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We supply and install projectors, screens and sound for homes, and set the system up so it is easy to use.

mainEntity.name: Where are you based?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brooklyn, New York. We work across the five boroughs, and the same crew travels for work outside the city.

mainEntity.name: How do we start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send the space, the dates and what it has to do through the quote form. We reply within 24 hours.

event-production-company-nyc.title: Event Production Company in NYC | Possible AV
event-production-company-nyc.desc: A New York event production company with the AV, lighting, staging, streaming, fabrication and crew in house, for launches, conferences, galas and activations.

mainEntity.name: What does an event production company do?

acceptedAnswer.text: It plans and runs the technical side of an event: staging, lighting, sound, screens, streaming and the crew. Possible AV also builds sets and interactive pieces in house.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with event planners and agencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work for brands directly, and with planners and agencies who set the creative and want one team to deliver it.

mainEntity.name: Can you produce an event outside New York?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The same crew and equipment travel from Brooklyn. See touring and out-of-town AV.

mainEntity.name: How far ahead should we book?

acceptedAnswer.text: As early as you can, especially for large events. Tight timelines are worth a message too: tell us the date.

mainEntity.name: Do you include LED walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: LED walls come from our sister site, ledwall.nyc, and we plan them into the same production.

projector-rental-nyc.title: Projector Rental NYC: Laser Projectors & Screens | Possible AV
projector-rental-nyc.desc: Projector and screen rental in New York City: Epson laser projectors up to 7,000 lumens, screens and projection mapping, delivered, set up and run by our crew.

mainEntity.name: How bright a projector do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the image size and how much light is in the space. For lit spaces and large screens we use Epson laser projectors up to 7,000 lumens; tell us the space and we will spec it.

mainEntity.name: Do you rent a projector with a screen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Projectors go out with the screen, stands or rigging, cabling and playback the job needs.

mainEntity.name: Can you project on a building or an object?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Projection mapping on walls, objects and irregular surfaces is part of our projection work.

mainEntity.name: Is setup included with a projector rental?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver, set up, focus and test it, and a technician can stay to run it.

mainEntity.name: Do you install home theater projectors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We rent projectors for home use and install home theater systems in New York.

sound-system-rental-nyc.title: Sound System & Speaker Rental NYC | Possible AV
sound-system-rental-nyc.desc: Sound system, PA and speaker rental in New York City, from one speaker and a mic to a flown line array, with an engineer to set it up and mix the show.

mainEntity.name: How big a sound system do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the space, the number of guests and what is on the program: speech, background music or a live band. Tell us those and we will size the system.

mainEntity.name: Does a sound system rental come with an engineer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We set it up and check it, and an engineer can stay to mix the show.

mainEntity.name: Can I rent just speakers for a party?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A pair of speakers with a microphone is a normal job, delivered and set up.

mainEntity.name: Do you rent directional speakers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We rent and sell directional speakers for exhibitions, stores and installs where the sound has to stay in one spot.

mainEntity.name: Do you install sound systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Background and zoned audio for stores, lobbies, offices and homes, installed and handed over.

microphone-rental-nyc.title: Wireless Microphone Rental NYC | Possible AV
microphone-rental-nyc.desc: Wireless microphone rental in New York City: handhelds, headsets and lavaliers, with frequency coordination, spares and a technician on site.

mainEntity.name: How many wireless microphones do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: One for each voice that can be live at the same moment, plus a spare. Our wireless microphone guide walks through common programs.

mainEntity.name: Can I rent microphones without a sound system?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can feed the microphones into the system already in your space, or bring speakers and a mixer as well.

mainEntity.name: Headset, lavalier or handheld?

acceptedAnswer.text: Handhelds are the most forgiving, headsets keep the level steady for presenters who move, and lavaliers are the most discreet. We will suggest a mix for your program.

mainEntity.name: Is a technician included?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A technician sets up and checks every channel, and can stay to run them during the event.

tv-rental-nyc.title: TV & Screen Rental NYC: OLED, Touch & Transparent | Possible AV
tv-rental-nyc.desc: TV and screen rental in New York City: OLED TVs, touch screens with Android or Windows, transparent displays and kiosks, delivered and set up by our crew.

mainEntity.name: Can I rent a TV for one day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Single-day TV rentals for events and meetings are a normal job, delivered and set up.

mainEntity.name: Do you rent touch screens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Touch screens with built-in Android or Windows, for kiosks, check-in, product catalogs and interactive pieces.

mainEntity.name: Do you load the content?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Send the files and we load and test them before the screens leave Brooklyn.

mainEntity.name: Can screens be wall mounted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Screens go out on stands or mounted to the wall, depending on the space.

mainEntity.name: Do you sell screens as well?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We sell and install touch screens and displays for offices, stores and showrooms.

event-lighting-rental-nyc.title: Event Lighting Rental NYC | Possible AV
event-lighting-rental-nyc.desc: Event lighting rental in New York City: Aputure lights, stage and wash lighting, a lighting desk and an operator, for galas, launches, panels and parties.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide an operator with the lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A lighting operator can run the desk for the whole event, and the crew sets up and strikes.

mainEntity.name: Can the lighting work on camera?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We light panels and talks so they look right in the space and on the stream.

mainEntity.name: Can you hang lights from truss?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Truss and rigging go out with the lighting when the space calls for it.

mainEntity.name: Do you also rent a stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Stage decks, truss and lighting can come together; see stage rental.

stage-rental-nyc.title: Stage & Truss Rental NYC: Staging for Events | Possible AV
stage-rental-nyc.desc: Stage, staging and truss rental in New York City: modular stage decks, stairs, skirting, truss and rigging, built and struck by our crew.

mainEntity.name: What size stage do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on how many people are on it and how far back the audience goes. Tell us the program and the headcount and we will size it.

mainEntity.name: Do you set up and take down the stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our crew builds the stage on site and strikes it at the end.

mainEntity.name: Can lighting and screens go on the stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Lighting, sound, screens and microphones come from the same crew, planned with the stage.

mainEntity.name: Do you rent truss on its own?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Truss and rigging can be rented for lights, screens or signs, set up by our crew.

event-wifi-rental-nyc.title: Event Wi-Fi & Internet Rental NYC | Possible AV
event-wifi-rental-nyc.desc: Temporary event Wi-Fi in New York City: access points, switching and a separate show network, with backup internet and monitoring while the event runs.

mainEntity.name: Why not use the building Wi-Fi?

acceptedAnswer.text: You cannot control it or see into it, and it is shared with everyone else. When streaming, check-in and payments depend on it, a network of your own is safer.

mainEntity.name: Can you provide internet for an event?

acceptedAnswer.text: We plan the internet connection with the space, add a backup path, and build the Wi-Fi and wired network on top.

mainEntity.name: Do you install permanent networks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. UniFi networks for offices and buildings, with structured cabling and support.

mainEntity.name: Is someone on site during the event?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The network is monitored while the event runs, with a technician on hand.

computer-rental-nyc.title: Computer & Workstation Rental NYC | Possible AV
computer-rental-nyc.desc: Computer and workstation rental in New York City: show computers, playback machines and high-end workstations for events and productions, set up by our crew.

mainEntity.name: What computers do you rent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Show computers for playback and presentations, and high-end workstations for real-time 3D, TouchDesigner and video work.

mainEntity.name: Do you set the computers up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We configure them for your software before delivery and connect them on site.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a workstation instead?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We build and sell custom PCs and workstations configured for your work.

mainEntity.name: Do you rent computers for exhibitions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Playback and interactive machines for exhibitions, galleries and installs, set to start on their own each day.

experiential-production-nyc.title: Experiential Production & Interactive Experiences NYC | Possible AV
experiential-production-nyc.desc: Experiential production in New York City: interactive installations, immersive projection, fabrication and the AV to run them, built in Brooklyn.

mainEntity.name: What is experiential production?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building the physical experience: the interactive pieces, the set, the projection and sound, and the crew that installs and runs it.

mainEntity.name: Do you design the experience or build what an agency designed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. Some projects come with creative direction from an agency or studio; on others we take it from the first sketch.

mainEntity.name: Can people interact with the piece?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We build interactive floors, walls and screens with sensors, body tracking and RFID or NFC triggers.

mainEntity.name: Can it be tested before the event?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Pieces are built and tested in Brooklyn before they are installed.

mainEntity.name: Can the experience travel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The same build and crew can go to several cities. See touring.
